projects.name: Vigil
projects.description:
Vigil is an AI security agent that autonomously protects cryptocurrency wallets by monitoring transactions, detecting threats, and blocking malicious activity in real-time - even while you sleep.
The Problem: $3.8B+ stolen annually through crypto scams. Existing tools only alert AFTER you're hacked. Users can't monitor wallets 24/7.
Our Solution: Autonomous protection using NEAR Shade Agents running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Vigil continuously monitors blockchain activity, scans smart contract approvals, detects suspicious patterns, and blocks threats before execution.
Key Features: Real NEAR wallet integration, live transaction monitoring, threat simulation, risk scoring, token approval scanning, complete audit trail, and user-owned encrypted data.
Tech Stack: NEAR Shade Agents, Chain Signatures, TEE (Phala Cloud), TypeScript, real-time blockchain integration.
Impact: First autonomous crypto security that actively protects, not just alerts.
projects.technologies: JavaScript, HTML, Node.js, TypeScript, Vercel, Ethereum, Near
